title: A stock tracker you can comfortably use at work
author: errrwin47
selftext:
You can check U.S. stock prices in an Excel-style interface. To anyone else, it just looks like you’re working.

[https://excelstock.net/](https://excelstock.net/)

The reason I built it is simple: opening a stock-trading dashboard at the office can feel a little awkward. So I designed the entire screen to look like an Excel spreadsheet. Even when your manager walks by, it just looks like you’re working late.

Here’s what it offers:

* Sort stocks by dollar volume, trading volume, top gainers, and top losers
* AI-powered stock analysis with automatically sourced related news articles
* A chat feature

When you select a stock, the AI finds the latest news about it and analyzes what may be driving the price movement.

To be completely transparent, I wasn’t satisfied with the quality of free AI models, so I’m currently paying out of pocket to use a more capable, up-to-date model. This feature genuinely costs money to operate, so I’m not sure how long I’ll be able to keep it free—it may depend on my bank balance, haha.

The service is currently fully self-funded, and I plan to keep it running for as long as my budget allows. Please try it out and feel free to share your honest feedback. In particular, let me know in the comments if there are any features you’d like to see, and I’ll do my best to add them.

Any feedback would be greatly appreciated!
